strongest_bounded_proposition: Medieval South India has evidence of slavery/dependency, but this packet does not establish it specifically for sampled Yadava/Devagiri.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not generalize Tamil-region inscriptional evidence to the Yadava polity because dates overlap.
terminology_category_qualification: Slavery/dependency intersected with caste, temple, household and agrarian relations.
temporal_scope_precision: Bounded to cited evidence; sample interval is not itself slavery evidence.
inference_extent: No inference beyond stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.

sources.title: Slavery and Dependency in Medieval South India
